power_tree.rule: isolated field domain disabled until allowed by USB power state

power_tree.source: B0505S-2WR3 or verified equivalent 2W isolated converter

component_roles.role: USB device controller + two UART/RS485 control paths + FDCAN + GPIO/ADC
isolated control/diagnostic path for high-side outputs

component_roles.preferred_part: 3.3V LDO or buck, exact part pending

topology_invariants: USB D+/D- terminate only at the USB-capable MCU path and required ESD/protection network.
No donor-internal rail or motherboard signal may appear in the BenchIO schematic.
RS485_A and RS485_B each cross an ISO1410 isolation barrier before reaching the field connector.
CAN crosses an ISO1042 isolation barrier before reaching CAN_H/CAN_L.
The shared field-side logic ground must not be copper-connected to GND_HOST.
ISO1212 field inputs must not depend on FIELD_9_30V to sense an external input.
TPS4H160 control/diagnostic paths cross digital isolation; output power comes from FIELD_9_30V.
Each bus gets connector-side transient protection and switchable termination where applicable.
Isolation moat contains no copper, stitching vias, test pads or mounting-hole copper that bridges GND_HOST and GND_FIELD.
Fabrication/power-on authority remains false even after ERC passes.
default_safe_state: RS485 transmit drivers disabled until firmware configuration.
CAN transmitter disabled/standby where supported until firmware configuration.
All digital outputs commanded OFF by hardware/firmware default.
isolated field logic power disabled until USB power state permits it.
no external field supply is sourced from USB.
acceptance_before_pcb: manufacturer datasheets frozen with hashes for every active component
exact package and pin mapping frozen
power budget proves USB current envelope
ISO1212 resistor network proves 18-30V input window
TPS4H160 current limit network frozen near 250mA/channel target
machine topology checker: zero invariant violations
independent review still pending unless separately recorded
